clues.text: God sent Jeremiah down to this worker's house, where he found him working at the wheel.
Jeremiah watched as a vessel this man was shaping became flawed, so he formed it into another one.
God told Jeremiah to buy a clay jar from this craftsman and take along elders and leading priests.
Zechariah threw his wages of thirty pieces of silver to this man in the house of the LORD.
After Judas threw back the silver, the chief priests used it to buy this man's field for burying foreigners.
Isaiah prayed, O LORD, You are our Father; we are the clay, and You are this.
Paul wrote that this maker may shape one lump of clay into vessels for special and common use.
